Thanks — technical confirmation below to answer Brian's question about log formats and retention APIs.

- Supported export formats: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) and gzipped CSV. Sample schema: {timestamp, request_id, user_id, action, resource, ip, user_agent, response_code}. I attached a 1-page sample event (FS-2026-1342_log_sample.ndjson).
- Retention: default 180 days. We have an admin API to set retention per-account (PUT /v1/admin/accounts/{id}/retention) — will document request/response and auth by EOD 4/16 and paste into the Drive.
- Audit log delivery: we support S3 push, secure FTP, and Drive upload via a service account. Recommend S3 for large exports; if FinServ prefers Drive, we can accept the files and run a one-off ingestion.

Attaching: FS-2026-1342_log_sample.ndjson (attachment stub)

-Dev
